messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout: runtime v2.14.0 -> prod at 2025-11-03 03:00 UTC (3h change window). Rolling EU -> NA -> APAC. Includes autoscale tuning + kernel patch. Tagging oncall: @maria @ashwin. Posting customer-facing statuspage + email drafts below — please review rollback gates.
maria: ack — I’m primary oncall for EU/NA this window. Recommend pinning Dedicated fleets to v2.13 for 1h after canary completes. Keep canary traffic low.
ashwin: +1. Canary plan: 5% traffic for 15m. Health gates: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 500ms, error rate < 0.5%. If any gate fails for 2 consecutive checks, hold rollout.
sara: Support copy ready, will tweak tone for enterprise accounts. Draft will include direct contact + SLA note. Also will prepare the statuspage incident and email batch.
kevin: Rollback playbook (ops):
- Stop rollout (manual)
- Scale fleets back to snapshot v2.13
- Reopen previous Autoscaler rules
- Run smoke tests (smoke.sh) against pinned fleet
- Notify customers via status and email (template below)
If rollback initiated, we estimate 20-45m recovery depending on in-flight requests.
maria: Statuspage snippet (draft):
```
We are performing a scheduled deployment to improve inference stability and autoscaling behavior.
Start: 2025-11-03 03:00 UTC
Expected window: 3 hours (rolling across EU, NA, APAC)
Potential impact: brief error spikes or increased latency for affected requests. We do not expect prolonged downtime; SLA remains in effect.
If you experience issues, contact support@redwood.ai or check https://status.redwood.ai for updates.
```
sara: Email template (customer-facing):
Subject: Scheduled maintenance — inference runtime update (Nov 3)
Body: Hello,
We will be deploying an update to our inference runtime on Nov 3 at 03:00 UTC (3-hour rolling window). This rollout will occur region-by-region across EU, NA, and APAC.
During the change window, you may see brief increases in latency or transient errors. If your workloads are latency‑sensitive or you run on Dedicated, reply to this message and we can arrange a temporary pin to v2.13 or a coordinated maintenance window.
We will post live updates to https://status.redwood.ai. Thank you for your patience.
— Redwood Support
deploy-bot: Note: auto-rollout will pause for a manual approval after canary. Rollback command (ops): `rb --to v2.13 --fleets eu,na,apac --force`
ashwin: I'll make rollback decision owner for 03:00-06:00 UTC. Trigger rollback if p50 > 200ms or errors > 1% sustained for 5m, or if customer-facing errors exceed threshold.
support-bot: Created incident draft incident-20251103-runtime-rollout-v2-14 and assigned to @sara. I will publish the initial status page message at 02:50 UTC to give customers a heads-up.
